supersedes.inheritance: All fields except the exact security-policy-presence override remain byte-semantically inherited from v4.

fieldOverrides.versionScope: Exact validated candidate repository commit and exact root or conditional non-recursive subtree Git object identity.
positiveFacts: A normal immutable Git blob at SECURITY.md, .github/SECURITY.md, or docs/SECURITY.md establishes present true.
fieldOverrides.negativeAbsenceSemantics: No repository-local path found remains unknown because an account-level default community-health security policy is outside the V1 local rule; present false is never emitted.
fieldOverrides.unresolvedRemainder: Account-level default policy and every non-registered effective source remain unresolved.
fieldOverrides.completenessRequirement: The successor rule establishes only positive present true. No negative closure exists in V1.
fieldOverrides.freshnessRequirement: Exact immutable commit, root tree, optional subtree, path, mode, type, and blob SHA are retained.
fieldOverrides.notApplicableRule: not permitted by the field registry
fieldOverrides.rationale: Immutable local positive evidence is field-semantic and attributable; local absence cannot close account-level defaults and therefore remains unknown.

changeControl: Only the diagnosed security-policy source and full-closure classification change. Planned capability, denominator, threshold, breadth, partial registry, and partial-evidence contract are unchanged.
